title: Unlicensed epistemic promotion — HYPOTHESIZED to OBSERVED without evidence
description: A trajectory where a claim transitions from HYPOTHESIZED to OBSERVED without any new evidence being added. Tests EPR detection (PCC-06). This is the canonical EPR violation fixture.
expected_instrument_behavior: EPR > 0; PCC-06 triggers; disposition PROTOCOL_NONCONFORMANT. Event must be preserved, not silently repaired.
